note:
Fills only, for the household already filed at 6 Park Valley, Stuart Cottage (#262) on the 1921 return: Mary Enfield at 79, her brother Henry at 71, an artist, Jane Chaffer her companion at 78, and two servants. All five are bound by number, so nothing is created and nothing already entered is overwritten. Their census rows carried no address and no source, which left no record of why they sit where they do; this writes both on.

**The house is 6 Park Valley, confirmed by A. Hagues.** Their schedule is nevertheless addressed **Broxtowe House**, which is also the address on Dr Kneebone's 1921 schedule for a house at the Park Terrace end of the estate, 230 metres away. A. Hagues does not accept Broxtowe House as a name for 6 Park Valley, so no such name is claimed for it here and none should be added to the property: the schedule's address is recorded as what the document says and nothing is inferred from it. Why that address appears on this household's return is unexplained and is part of the open question. Henry is returned as Mary's brother and they are linked as siblings here. See [[broxtowe-house-where]].
source: 1921 census, 6 Park Valley (Stuart Cottage); the house confirmed by A. Hagues. The schedule itself is addressed Broxtowe House, which is recorded but not treated as a name for this house.
